name: Aiwt
notes: Exported without KV-cache (optimum-cli export onnx --task text2text-generation, not -with-past). Must load with use_cache=False. Only encoder_model.onnx + decoder_model.onnx exist - no decoder_model_merged.onnx or decoder_with_past_model.onnx.
Weights are dynamically int8-quantized via onnxruntime.quantization.quantize_dynamic (architecture-agnostic, not tied to a specific CPU instruction set).

tie_word_embeddings must be false in config.json. This checkpoint's shared.weight and lm_head.weight are genuinely different tensors after fine-tuning. Some transformers versions (pre-5.x observed) silently force-tie them per the base model's inherited config default, discarding the fine-tuned output layer entirely and producing degenerate repetitive output. Always verify tie_word_embeddings is false before shipping a retrained version of this model.

emoji must not appear in training targets - flan-t5-small's tokenizer has no emoji tokens, they silently become <unk> and get lost. Which emoji to show is a plain lookup from streak_bucket, done in serving code, not generated by the model.
